fact: In a memorandum of understanding signed on 6 February 2026 the Burundi Government commits to use SIDAinfo as its electronic medical records and to roll it out in 460 facilities by 2026 and 572 by 2028, with the U.S. Government planning to fund about $1,829,216 for SIDAinfo over the term ($565,579 in 2026) and Burundi committing to pay the remaining licensing, hosting and hardware costs; the same text commits Burundi to DHIS2 as its national health data warehouse, with about $609,872 of U.S. funding.
title: Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the United States of America and the Government of Burundi
publisher: Government of the United States of America and Government of Burundi (released by the U.S. Department of State, FL-2026-00021; hosted by Public Citizen)
